authority: Preparation only. This specification does not execute or alter the shared renderer, normalize any original object in place, write the website, or authorize publication.

native_contract.source_ready: sources/SOURCE_READY.json with all_assets_in_original_order and original_api_file_object; retain complete original PDF-before-ZIP order
native_contract.receipts: sources/api-receipts.json is a five-item list with requested_url, started/completed_utc, HTTP_status, final_url, ordered response_headers_in_received_order, body and original flags. No sources/receipt.json exists or is invented.
native_contract.normalized_view: A later root-owned read-only presentation adapter may map key to a presentation name and asset path while preserving every original object and ordered headers whole. The private configs already embed the full native objects.
native_contract.archives: The single public ZIP is the complete original native asset. It includes three original nested evidence archives and a byte-identical embedded note.pdf; only one unique public reader is presented.

custom_status_contract.source_ready_early_flags: Preserve target_mathematics_not_yet_read=true and originals_now_immutable=true exactly in the historical SOURCE_READY object; later editorial/scientific state is separate.
custom_status_contract.analytic: Preserve full assessment FULL_ORIGINAL_FINITE_THEOREM_AND_ATTAINMENT_SUPPORTED, promotion_authority=false and original root_cross_family_scientific_decision_pending=true.
custom_status_contract.editorial_status: PRIVATE_EDITORIAL_PREPARED_UNPUBLISHED. The shared renderer expects generic gate.status=PASS, so it must not be run directly against this package. Root must separately authorize integration and consult exact scientific authority rather than rewrite any original status.

field_mapping.title: Exact h1, document title, scholarly/citation title
field_mapping.abstract: Complete original abstract in indexable HTML and scholarly abstract
field_mapping.abstract_heading: Original abstract; current shared generic path would hardcode Abstract for this unlisted record, so later per-page adaptation is required. Never prepend a label inside the abstract to bypass that behavior.
field_mapping.result: The precise result including operator, normalization, fixed finite witness, fractions and both finite positive-time maxima
field_mapping.why_it_works: Why the result holds; retain classical credit and analytic role of infinite/all-time estimates
field_mapping.limitations: Dimension3 boundary, witness-versus-maximizer distinction, classical method credit and bounded source/priority limits
field_mapping.background: Linked positively credited original question and classical antecedents
field_mapping.ai_disclosure: Extensive AI; unrefereed; no external human/journal peer review or proof-assistant certification
field_mapping.collaboration: Passive substantive contribution-based invitation; no individualized outreach
field_mapping.canonical_url: null until root authorization and verification; proposed_canonical_url is a private plan, not a live URL
field_mapping.source_binding: Private only, no whole native objects or audit dates/counts in public copy

later_renderer_requirements: Handle native receipt list without changing source schema.
Honor Original abstract heading, explicit local PDF download attribute and complete ZIP/local/Zenodo link set.
Include CC BY4.0 and exact citation.bib; current hardcoded whitelist does not include23383952.
Display full four-page reader with accessible title and direct-open fallback.
Preserve mathematical symbols and full indexable statement; ASCII exponent notation in prose may be typeset semantically without changing equations.
Keep all private statuses, source paths, hashes, current review timestamps and counts out of page/schema.
Use one approved canonical consistently in title/meta/schema/index/sitemap only after root acts.
